samples: This module defines a small arithmetic expression tree with numbers, addition, multiplication, and negation. It can recursively evaluate a tree to a decimal result and render the same tree as fully parenthesized infix text. Its main program builds one sample expression and prints both the expression and its computed value, so it is useful as a simple demo or reference implementation for tree-based expression handling.
